About the job

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Programmer to join our team in Tampa, FL.

The Programmer will leverage their strong technical background and knowledge to provide programming services for a variety of specific systems and business, military, scientific, or commercial applications.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Provide programming services for a variety of specific systems and business, military, scientific, or commercial applications
  • Participate in systems analysis, design definition, software development, systems test, implementation, and maintenance
  • Analyze coding problems and develop improvements to procedures and existing software
  • Design, develop, troubleshoot, debug, and implement software code, including HTML, CGI, and JavaScript, for website components
  • Cultivate and apply a security-first and test-first approach to test-driven development
  • Exercise independent judgment in developing methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions in cloud and containerized environments

Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and 4+ years of mid-level experience
  • Strong professional experience in software development and programming using modern languages such as JavaScript, Python, and HTML
  • Proven expertise to design, develop, troubleshoot, debug, and implement high-quality code
  • Hands-on experience working in a wide variety of computing environments, specifically including cloud platforms and containerized solutions
  • Demonstrated experience applying test-driven development and secure coding practices

Preferred Qualifications
  • 6+ years of experience
  • Advanced experience with modern web development frameworks such as React, Angular, or Django
  • Experience with specific cloud infrastructure platforms like AWS or Azure
  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies as well as CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience using Generative AI for software development

Clearance Requirements
  • An active Secret clearance with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI

Physical Requirements
  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc..
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations.
  • Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

About Us:
At MANTECH, we believe national security demands more than technology—it requires an unwavering dedication to the mission and the warfighters who defend it. For nearly 60 years, we have considered our work a matter of public trust, engineering the strategic advantage needed to secure the nation, protect our communities, and advance global health care.

The modern battlespace is complex, volatile, and deeply interconnected. When federal managers, intelligence professionals, and military leaders face unrelenting operational hurdles, they don’t need a vendor. They need a trusted advisor who has navigated these high-stakes environments before. We bring battle-tested credibility and a sense of urgency to every challenge, helping our heroes overcome their toughest battles to achieve ultimate success.

Engineered for Mission Success:
We continually innovate to deliver high-tech solutions across the Defense & Space, Intelligence & Homeland Security, and Commercial sectors:
* Cyberspace Superiority: Full-spectrum operations built to anticipate aggressive digital threats, secure critical supply chains, and dominate the domain.
* Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI): Transforming fragmented data into near real-time, actionable insights that accelerate decision-making at the tactical edge.
* Digital Modernization & Systems Engineering: Utilizing Agile DevSecOps and advanced digital twinning to build resilient, cloud-native architectures from the ground up.

Powered by Mission-First Talent:
Our depth is rooted in the people who live the mission firsthand. Comprised of more than 9,000 talented employees around the world, nearly 40% of our workforce are veterans. Many others join us directly from the Intelligence Community, Homeland Security, and commercial agencies. We understand your challenges because we know your world firsthand.

MANTECH | Always Advancing

Commitments

Career growth and learning

MANTECH is deeply committed to its workforce, fostering a culture where career development and continuous growth are paramount. We empower our employees with diverse opportunities, cutting-edge training, and mentorship programs, ensuring they can expand their expertise, advance their careers, and ultimately, thrive in their roles while contributing to critical national security missions.

Work-life balance

MANTECH demonstrates its profound commitment to its workforce through our comprehensive Total Rewards and MANTECH Cares benefits program. We prioritize fostering an exceptional work-life balance and promoting a truly healthy work environment. Our suite of robust wellness programs, including initiatives for physical, mental, and financial well-being, offers a 360-degree total care package designed to support every aspect of our employees' lives, ensuring they thrive both professionally and personally.
